title: NPTEL | PPTX - Slideshare
description: NPTEL is a joint initiative between IITs and IISc that began in 2003 to provide open online courses and resources. It focuses on higher education, professional education, distance education, and continuous learning. The central idea is to record lectures from IIT professors and make them freely available on YouTube so students globally can access them. NPTEL has over 990 courses available for self-learning across various disciplines through video lectures, PDFs, and other files that can be downloaded. title: NPTEL
description: ## HOW TO ACCESS TRANSLATED CONTENT IN NPTEL SITE. ### ACCESS TRANSLATED CONTENT - LECTURE WISE. ## GO TO COURSE. Visit https://nptel.ac.in. Search for your desired course (course will be available only if translated in that language). Go to the course page. ## ACCESS TRANSLATED PDF. Click on desired language tab (tabs will be available only the course is translated in that language). Go to the specific lecture number. Click on "Download" link to view / save the translated content. ### ACCESS TRANSLATED EBOOK. ## Access E-Book via course page. Search for your desired course. "Click to Download" for viewing / saving the e-Book as PDF. ## Access E-Book. Click on "Download" against desired language. for viewing / saving the e-Book as PDF. ### ACCESS COURSE WISE TRANSLATED CONTENT. if so, click on "Click here" link against the course. You will be taken to the course specific page. Translated content can be accessed via "Transcript" tab in course page.
